questions.prompt: Write the correct form of the verb in brackets.
questions.explanation: Verbs ending in -ch, -sh, -s, -x add -es with he/she/it: watches.

wrongReasons.watch: With he, she and it the verb needs -es.

questions.prompt: Write the correct form of the verb in brackets.
questions.explanation: Negative present simple with they: don't + base verb.

wrongReasons.doesn't work: 'doesn't' is used with he, she and it.
wrongReasons.not work: You need the auxiliary 'don't' before the verb.

questions.prompt: Write the correct form of the verb in brackets.
questions.explanation: When a verb ends in consonant + y, change y to -ies: study → studies.

questions.prompt: Write the correct form of the verb in brackets.
questions.explanation: With I, use the base form: I have.

wrongReasons.has: 'has' is only used with he, she and it.

questions.prompt: Write the correct form of the verb in brackets.
questions.explanation: After 'does', use the base form of the verb: does she like?

wrongReasons.liked: After 'does' the verb stays in the base form.

questions.prompt: Write the correct form of the verb in brackets.
questions.explanation: With he, she and it add -s: Tom plays.

questions.prompt: Write the correct form of the verb in brackets.
questions.text: My mother ___ (watch) TV in the evening.
questions.explanation: Verbs ending in -ch add -es with he, she and it: watches.

questions.prompt: Write the correct form of the verb in brackets.
questions.explanation: After "doesn't" use the base form: He doesn't eat.

wrongReasons.eating: After "doesn't" use the base form, not -ing.

questions.prompt: Write the correct form of the verb in brackets.
questions.explanation: After "is" use the verb + -ing: is reading.

wrongReasons.reads: After "is" we need the -ing form, not -s.

questions.prompt: Write the correct form of the verb in brackets.
questions.explanation: "have" changes to "has" with he, she and it: The baby has.

wrongReasons.haves: "haves" is not correct. The form is "has".
